description: Collects the tax imposed by the City Treasurer's Office on natural or juridical persons who own or administer real property, including improvements.
typeOfTransaction: G2C/G2B – Government to Client / Government to Business
steps: Obtain a queue number and present the latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment.
Pay the required real property tax and receive the issued Official Receipt.
requirements: Latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment (original or 1 photocopy)
Authorization letter and valid IDs of the owner and representative, if transacting through a representative

detailedRequirements.requirement: Latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment (original or 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: To be provided by the client

detailedRequirements.requirement: Authorization letter and valid IDs of the owner and representative, if transacting through a representative
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Property owner and government issuing agency

clientSteps.action: Present the latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment for verification and computation of the Real Property Tax.
Pay the required fees. The payment will be accepted and an Official Receipt will be issued.

fees.description: AV × 1% × 2 for Basic Tax and Special Education Fund, less any applicable discount if paid by March 31. Delinquent accounts are charged an additional 2% penalty per month of delay, not exceeding 36 months.

feeSchedule.name: Current Real Property Tax
feeSchedule.amount: Assessed Value × 1% × 2 (Basic Tax and Special Education Fund), less any applicable discount

feeSchedule.name: Delinquent Real Property Tax
feeSchedule.amount: Assessed Value × 1% × 2 (Basic Tax and Special Education Fund), plus a 2% penalty per month of delay, not exceeding 36 months

processingTime: 15 minutes, depending on the assessed value

quickInfo.processingTime: 15 minutes, depending on the assessed value
